description: Look up many CVEs at once, each with the fields of cve_lookup. Ids beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed. Costs 1 credit per CVE ID looked up, at least 1.
name: cve_lookup_bulk

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

failed.description: Well-formed IDs not in the database or unreadable. Counted only here, not in results.

not_processed.description: Well-formed IDs the credit budget did not cover. They were not looked up.

processed.description: Well-formed IDs that were looked up. Equals successful + failed.

affected_product_count.description: All products of the CVE; affected_products holds the first 20.

cpe_part.description: a, o or h from the CPE name: application, operating system or hardware. Absent on a cna element.

default_status.description: affected, unaffected or unknown from the CNA; null if none. Absent on an nvd element.

product.description: null when the CPE name leaves the product open.

vendor.description: null when the CPE name leaves the vendor open.

version_start_including.description: Absent when the range has no such bound. The same holds for each other version_* member.

versions.description: The CNA's version entries as written; null if none. Only on a cna element.

cve_tags.description: Tags of the CVE record from NVD or the CNA, such as disputed.

cvss_v3.description: Base score, 0-10. null without a v3 vector.

cvss_v3_source.description: Source: nvd, cna (the CVE's CNA), adp (CISA's ADP) or other (any other source). null if none recorded.

cvss_v4.description: Base score, 0-10. null without a v4 vector.

cvss_v4_source.description: Coded as cvss_v3_source; chosen apart from it.

cwe_id.description: Main CWE, such as CWE-79. Empty when none is known.

cwe_source.description: Source of cwe_id, coded as cvss_v3_source; null if none recorded.

epss_percentile.description: Share of scored CVEs with an equal or lower EPSS score, 0-1. null with epss_score.

epss_score.description: EPSS probability, 0-1, of exploitation in the next 30 days. null if unscored.

epss_trend.description: Daily EPSS history, newest first, up to 30 days.

ghsa.description: Link that asks /cve_lookup for this CVE's GitHub advisory.

has_metasploit_module.description: null when the Metasploit feed is not loaded.

kev_date_added.description: YYYY-MM-DD it entered CISA KEV. null if not in KEV or undated.

metasploit_module_count.description: null when the Metasploit feed is not loaded.

count.description: All templates of the CVE; templates holds up to 5.

reason.description: not_synced; present only when available is false.

product_count_by_vendor.description: Up to 10 vendors with the most products, and each one's count.

ransomware_campaign.description: Known or Unknown for a KEV entry. null outside KEV.

severity.description: From CVSS v3, else v4, else v2: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, NONE (score 0.0), or UNKNOWN (no CVSS).

ssvc.description: CISA's SSVC assessment. null when CISA has not assessed the CVE.

mission_wellbeing.description: CISA's decision per mission and well-being impact level of the system's operator. Read high if the level is unknown. Members are described under low.

decision.description: Track, Track* (Track, watched closer), Attend or Act, least to most urgent.

remediation_advice.description: CISA's timeline: standard updates for Track and Track*, sooner for Attend, as soon as possible for Act.

scored_at.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. null when the time is not known.

vulnerability_status.description: NVD status, such as Analyzed, Modified, Deferred or Rejected. May be empty.

skipped.description: Elements that are not a well-formed CVE ID.

successful.description: IDs found; results holds their records.

total.description: Elements submitted. Equals processed + skipped + the length of not_processed.

title: Bulk CVE Lookup
